title: Finale Mortar Rack — Bill of Materials
per_unit: One rack (5 rows × 5 tubes). Build qty 2 for the full finale.

standard_stock.name: 4×8 sheet (plywood)
standard_stock.notes: Walls for both racks on one sheet

parts.name: End wall (front & back)
parts.notes: 23-3/8 × 3-1/2 in. (+1 in. each side in X). Top-half lap at green crossings.

parts.name: Green divider (+X)
parts.notes: 6× 17-7/8 × 3-1/2 in. (same size; positions from divider_offset_from_center_in[0..5]). Bottom-half lap at brown ends.

tips: Each rack is 5×5 (25 tubes); build two racks for 50-tube finale.
Footprint per rack ~20-3/8 × 14-7/8 in. tube bay (green boards 17-7/8 in. long along depth).
Label racks A/B if row angles or fuse wiring differ.
